name: Coconut Cake
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: oz. can Coco Lopez cream of coconut

instructions:
Prepare yellow cake mix according to pkg. directions.

While cake is still warm, pour over top of cake a mixture of 1 can Coco Lopez cream of coconut (15 oz.) and 1 can Eagle Brand milk (14 oz.).

Let cake cool completely, top with 8 oz. container of Cool-Whip. Sprinkle with 3 1/2 oz. can Bakers Coconut. Refrigerate until served.
